cost_model: all group operations for [u]Q and [v]Q are charged
all public coefficient construction, local regularization and field inversions are charged
every quadratic character and sign multiplication is charged
enumerative search is discovery work rather than evaluator advice

mixed_rational_atoms.admission: the two pulled lines have equal local order at every tested subgroup point
mixed_rational_atoms.canonicalization: unordered pair of pulled-line templates because chi(R)=chi(R^-1)
mixed_rational_atoms.regular_value: if the common order is m, divide c_num*alpha_{u,P}^m by c_den*alpha_{v,P}^m

pulled_line_templates.etale_condition: p does not divide u and gcd(u,n)=1 on every frozen curve

transfer_gate.claim_boundary: Failure closes only the declared mixed-pullback line-ratio grammar through product weight four.
transfer_gate.discovery: one symbolic mixed-pullback AST must be exact on all five base discovery curves
transfer_gate.holdout: the same AST must be exact on all thirteen base holdout curves
